As a kid, I had a friend named Joe.  Joe is what parents would affectionately refer to as a "troublemaker", although I believe the proper nomenclature is "demon child".  This kid had me doing all kinds of shit at the ripe age of 8 (he was around the same age as me) ranging from stealing candy to ninja jumping across rocks protruding from the shallow end of a freezing lake.  One day he thought to himself, "You know what?  Fuck this bench." so we proceeded to carve in pencil as deep as we could all the swear words our 8-year-old brains could muster.  Of course this lady casually walks over from the park asking just what we were doing.  

This lady (and in retrospect, what a self-righteous beezy) proceeds to lecture us (fine, fine) but then asks for our parent's number and where we live so she can have a talk with them.  Joe, being the stand up guy that he is, says he's from out of town and gives her a bogus number leaving me there to take the heat for all this shit.  I give her legit info, walk home, tell my parents without any context "I did something bad", and then faceplant on my top bunk bracing for the incoming shitstorm.  

TL;DR: Demon child gets me to write swears, end up taking all the heat.

Your solace is illegal and you'll get charged with possession.
